submission.title: Remote Typist
submission.description: Urgently hiring remote data entry typists. No experience needed. Contact via Telegram @FastCashRecruiter. Selected candidates must transfer ₹8,500 security kit deposit via UPI PhonePe.

warningSigns.title: Upfront Candidate Payment or Deposit Requested
warningSigns.evidence: Explicitly marked as requiring payment (₹8,500 deposit via PhonePe). Text mentions: "deposit"
warningSigns.explanation: Legitimate employers cover recruitment, background verification, and equipment costs. Demanding candidate deposits (via UPI, cash, or wire transfer) is the #1 indicator of employment fraud according to consumer protection regulators.
warningSigns.recommendation: Cease communication immediately if asked to send money via UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) or bank transfer. Legitimate employers never charge candidates.

warningSigns.title: Informal / Encrypted Messaging Interview
warningSigns.evidence: Recruitment directs candidates to communicate via messaging platforms (Telegram / WhatsApp mentioned in description).
warningSigns.explanation: Scammers avoid traceable corporate email servers and telephone networks by conducting fake interviews solely through encrypted chat apps with anonymous accounts.
warningSigns.recommendation: Request a formal video interview via corporate enterprise software (e.g. Google Meet, Zoom) with an official corporate email invitation.

warningSigns.title: Upfront Candidate Payment or Deposit Requested
warningSigns.evidence: Explicitly marked as requiring payment (Registration/Equipment fee). Text mentions: "deposit"
warningSigns.explanation: Legitimate employers cover recruitment, background check, and training costs. Demanding candidate deposits or equipment purchases is the #1 indicator of employment scams according to the FTC.
warningSigns.recommendation: Cease communication immediately if asked to send money, buy gift cards, or transfer crypto. Legitimate employers never charge candidates.

warningSigns.title: Personal Email Used for Corporate Recruitment
warningSigns.evidence: Contact email "hr-apex@gmail.com" uses free provider @gmail.com rather than an official domain matching "Apex Global Logistics LLC".
warningSigns.explanation: Established organizations utilize proprietary corporate email domains (e.g. hr@company.com). Free email addresses are frequently used by impersonators pretending to be corporate recruiters.
warningSigns.recommendation: Search for the recruiter on LinkedIn or visit the company official careers page to verify if this email address is legitimate.

warningSigns.title: Disproportionately High Compensation for Entry-Level Role
warningSigns.evidence: Advertised pay ($45/hr) is significantly above industry benchmarks for entry-level or no-experience positions.
warningSigns.explanation: Scammers offer inflated wages (e.g. $45–$65/hr for basic data entry or typing) as an emotional hook to attract urgent, uncritical applicants.
warningSigns.recommendation: Compare the offered salary against trusted compensation benchmarks (e.g., Glassdoor, Bureau of Labor Statistics) for this specific job title.
